What Is Heavy-Duty Vehicle Recovery?

Heavy-duty vehicle recovery is the recovery and transportation of larger or heavier vehicles. These vehicles need different equipment and handling compared with a standard car.

The appropriate recovery method depends on factors such as:

  • Vehicle size and weight
  • Vehicle type
  • Current condition
  • Whether the vehicle is running
  • Location of the vehicle
  • Accessibility of the recovery location
  • Distance it needs to be transported
  • Type of damage or mechanical problem

Because every recovery situation is different, accurate vehicle and location information helps us arrange the right recovery from the start.

GOOD TO KNOW

When Do You Need Heavy-Duty Recovery?

A heavy or commercial vehicle needs professional recovery when it cannot safely continue its journey. Common situations include:

Heavy Vehicle Breakdown

Mechanical or electrical faults can leave a larger vehicle immobilised. If roadside assistance cannot get the vehicle moving safely, recovery is required.

Commercial Vehicle Breakdown

A commercial vehicle that becomes immobilised affects deliveries, work schedules and business operations. Professional recovery moves the vehicle to a suitable destination for inspection or repair, so you can get back to work sooner.

Accident-Damaged Heavy Vehicles

Following an accident, a larger vehicle may be unsafe or impossible to drive. Recovery requirements depend on the extent and location of the damage.

Non-Running Heavy Vehicles

A vehicle that will not start can be transported to a garage, workshop or another agreed location.

Planned Heavy Vehicle Transportation

Heavy-duty recovery is also used when a larger vehicle needs to be moved between locations and cannot or should not be driven.

AT A GLANCE

Heavy-Duty Breakdown Recovery in Birmingham

A heavy vehicle breakdown is more complicated than a standard car breakdown because of the vehicle’s size, weight and operating requirements.

When you call, it helps to have the following ready:

  • Vehicle type, make and model
  • Approximate size or weight
  • Registration number
  • Exact location
  • Description of the problem
  • Whether the vehicle starts
  • Whether it can roll and steer
  • Where you want it taken

Commercial vehicles are essential for day-to-day business operations. A breakdown is more than an inconvenience: it can interrupt deliveries, appointments and work schedules.

Heavy-Duty Recovery After an Accident

A collision can leave a large or commercial vehicle unable to continue safely. If the wheels, steering, suspension, bodywork or other important components are damaged, attempting to drive it is not appropriate.

In these situations, professional recovery moves the vehicle from the accident location to a suitable destination, such as a garage, workshop or secure storage.

How Heavy-Duty Vehicle Recovery Works

The process varies depending on the vehicle and situation, but it always starts with understanding the vehicle’s condition and location.

KEY SITUATIONS

What Can Affect Heavy-Duty Recovery?

Heavy-duty recovery is not the same for every vehicle. Several factors affect how the recovery is carried out.

Vehicle Weight

The size and weight of the vehicle influence the equipment and recovery method required.

Vehicle Condition

A running vehicle has different recovery requirements from one with mechanical or accident damage.

Access to the Vehicle

Narrow roads, restricted areas, car parks and difficult access can all affect the recovery process.

Recovery Distance

A short local recovery and a longer transportation journey need different arrangements. For an accurate quote, give us as much information as possible when you contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery.
